verses: Alif Laam Meem Ra. Yeh Quran ki aayaten hain, aur jo kuch aap ki taraf aap kay rab ki janib say utara jata hai, sab haq hai lekin aksar log eman nahi latay

Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano ko baghair satoonon kay buland ker rakha hai kay tum ussay dekh rahey ho. Phir woh arsh per qarar pakray huye hai, ussi ney sooraj aur chand ko ma-tehati mein laga rakha hai. Her aik miyad moyyen per gasht ker raha hai, o hi kaam ki tadbeer kerta hai woh apney nishanaat khol khol ker biyan ker raha hai kay tum apney rab ki mulaqat ka yaqeen ker lo

Ussi ney zamin phela ker bicha di hai aur uss mein pahar aur nehren peda kerdi hain. Aur uss mein her qasam kay phalon kay joray dohray dohray peda kerdiye hain, woh raat ko din say chupa deta hai. Yaqeenan ghor ghor-o-fiker kerney walon kay liye uss mein boht si nishaniyan hain

Aur zamin mein mukhtalif tukray aik doosray say lagtay lagatay hain aur angooron kay baghaat hain aur khet hain aur khujooron kay darakht hain, shaakh daar aur baaz aisay hain jo bey shaakh hain sab aik hi pani pilaye jatay hain. Phir bhi hum aik ko aik per phalon mein bartari detay hain uss mein aqal mandon kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain

Agar tujhay tajjub ho to waqaee unn ka yeh kehna ajeeb hai kay kiya jab hum mitti ho jayen gay. To kiya hum naee pedaeesh mein hun gay? Yehi woh log hain jinhon ney apney perwerdigar say kufur kiya. Yehi hain jin ki gardano mein toq hun gay aur yehi hain jo jahannum kay rehney walay hain jo uss mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay

Aur jo tujh say (saza ki talbi mein) jald ker rahey hain rahat say pehlay hi, yaqeenan unn say pehlay sazayen (bator misal) guzar chuki hain, aur be-shak tera rab albatta bakhshney wala hai logon kay bey jaa zulm per bhi. Aur yeh bhi yaqeeni baat hai kay tera rab bari sakht saza denay wala bhi hai
Aur kafir kehtay hain kay uss per uss kay rab ki taraf say koi nishani (moajza) kiyon nahi utari gaee. Baat yeh hai kay aap to sirf aagah kerney walay hain. Aur her qom kay liye hadi hai
Madah apney shikam mein jo kuch rakhti hai ussay Allah bakhoobi janta hai aur pet ka ghatna barhna bhi, her cheez uss kay pass andazay say hai
Zahir o posheedah ka woh aalam hai (sab say) bara aur (sab say) buland bala
Tum mein say kissi ka apni baat ko chupa ker kehna aur ba-aawaz buland ussay kehna aur jo raat ko chupa hua ho aur jo din mein chal raha ho, sab Allah per barabar o yaksan hain

Uss kay pehray daar insan kay aagay peechay muqarrar hain, jo Allah kay hukum say uss ki nigehbani kertay hain. Kissi qom ki halat Allah Taalaa nahi badalta jab tak kay woh khud ussay na badlen jo unn kay dilon mein hai. Allah Taalaa jab kissi qom ki saza ka iradah ker leta hai to woh badla nahi kerta aur siwaye uss kay koi bhi unn ka kaarsaaz nahi
Woh Allah hi hai jo tumhen bijli ki chamak daraney aur umeed dilaney kay liye dikhata hai aur bhari badlon ko peda kerta hai

Garaj uss ki tasbeeh o tareef kerti hai aur farishtay bhi, uss kay khof say. O hi aasman say bijliyan girata hai aur jiss per chahata hai uss per dalta hai kuffaar Allah ki babat larr jhagar rahey hain aur Allah sakht qooat wala hai

Ussi ko pukarna haq hai. Jo log auron ko uss kay siwa pukartay hain woh unn (ki pukar) ka kuch bhi jawab nahi detay magar jaisay koi shakhs apney dono hath pani ki taraf phelaye huye ho kay uss kay mun mein parr jaye halankay woh pani uss kay mun mein phonchney wala nahi, unn munkiron ki jitni pukar hai sab gumrahi mein hai
Allah hi kay liye zamin aur aasmano ki sab makhlooq khushi aur khushi say sajdah kerti hai aur unn kay saye bhi subha o shaam

Aap poochiye kay aasmano aur zamin ka perwerdigar kaun hai? Keh dijiye! Allah. Keh dijiye! kiya tum phir bhi uss kay siwa auron ko himayati bana rahey ho jo khud apni jaan kay bhi bhalay buray ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay. Keh dijiye kay kiya andha aur beena barabar ho sakta hai? Ya kiya andheriyan aur roshni barabar ho sakti hai. Kiya jinhen yeh Allah kay shareek thehra rahey hain unhon ney bhi Allah ki tarah makhlooq peda ki hai kay unn ki nazar mein pedaeesh mushtaba hogaee ho, keh dijiye kay sirf Allah hi tamam cheezon ka khaliq hai woh akela hai aur zabardast ghalib hai

Ussi ney aasman say pani barsaya phir apni apni wusat kay mutabiq nalay beh niklay. Phir pani kay railay ney upper charhay jhaag ko utha liya, aur uss cheez mein bhi jiss ko aag mein daal ker tapatay hain zewar ya saaz o saman kay liye ussi tarah kay jhaag hain, ussi tarah Allah Taalaa haq o baatil ki misal biyan farmata hai, abb jhaag to nakara ho ker chala jata hai lekin jo logon ko nafa denay wali cheez hai woh zamin mein thehri rehti hai, Allah Taalaa ussi tarah misalen biyan farmata hai

Jin logon ney apney rab kay hukum ki baja aawari ki unn kay liye bhalaee hai aur jin logon ney uss ki hukum bardari na ki agar unn kay liye zamin mein jo kuch hai sab kuch ho aur ussi kay sath wesa hi aur bhi ho to woh sab kuch apney badlay mein dey den. Yehi hain jin kay liye bura hisab hai aur jin ka thikana jahannum hai jo boht buri jagah hai

Kiya woh aik shakhs jo yeh ilm rakhta ho kay aap ki taraf aap kay rab ki janib say jo utara gaya hai woh haq hai, uss shakhs jaisa ho sakta hai jo andha ho naseehat to o hi qabool kertay hain jo aqalmand hun
Jo Allah kay ehad (o-paymaan) ko poora kertay hain aur qol o qarar ko tortay nahi
Aur Allah ney jin cheezon kay jorney ka hukum diya hai woh ussay jortay hain aur woh apney perwerdigar say dartay hain aur hisab ki sakhti ka andesha rakhtay hain

Aur woh apney rab ki raza mandi ki talab kay liye sabar kertay hain, aur namazon ko barabar qaeem rakhtay hain aur jo kuch hum ney unhen dey rakha hai ussay chupay khulay kharach kertay hain aur buraee ko bhi bhalaee say taaltay hain, unn hi kay liye aaqibat ka ghar hai
Hamesha rehney kay baghaat jahan yeh khud jayen gay aur unn kay baap dadon aur biwiyon aur auladon mein say bhi jo neko kaar hun gay, unn kay pass farishtay her her darwazay say aayen gay
Kahen gay kay tum per salamti ho, sabar kay badlay, kiya hi acha (badla) hai uss daar aakhirat ka

Aur jo Allah kay ehad ko uss ki mazbooti kay baad tor detay hain aur jin cheezon jorney ka Allah ney hukum diya hai unhen tortay hain aur zamin mein fasad phelatay hain, unn kay liye laanaten hain aur unn kay liye bura ghar hai
Allah Taalaa jiss ki rozi chahata hai barhata hai aur ghatata hai yeh to duniya ki zindagi mein mast ho gaye. Halankay duniya aakhirat kay muqablay mein nihayat (haqeer) poonji hai

Kafir kehtay hain kay uss per koi nishani (moajza) kiyon nazil nahi kiya gaya? Jawab dey dijiye kay jissay Allah gumrah kerna chahaye ker deta hai aur jo uss ki taraf jhukay ussay raasta dikha deta hai
Jo log eman laye unn kay dil Allah kay zikar say itminan hasil kertay hain. Yaad rakho Allah kay zikar say hi dilon ko tasalli hasil hoti hai
Jo log eman laye aur jinhon ney nek kaam bhi kiye unn kay liye khushali hai aur behtareen thikana

Ussi tarah hum ney aap ko uss ummat mein bheja hai jiss say pehlay boht si ummaten guzar chuki hain kay aap unhen humari taraf say jo wahee aap per utri hai parh ker sunaiye yeh Allah rehman kay munkir hain, aap keh dijiye kay mera paalney wala to o hi hai uss kay siwa dar-haqeeqat koi bhi laeeq ibadat nahi, ussi kay upper mera bharosa hai aur ussi ki janib mera rujoo hai

Agar (bil-farz) kissi Quran (aasmani kitab) kay zariye pahar chala diye jatay ya zamin tukray tukray ker di jati ya mardon say baaten kera di jatin (phir bhi woh eman na latay), baat yeh hai kay sab kaam Allah kay hath mein hai, to kiya eman walon ko uss baat per dil jamaee nahi kay agar Allah Taalaa chahaye to tamam logon ko hidayat dey dey. Kuffaar ko to unn kay kufur kay badlay hamesha hi koi na koi sakht saza phonchti rahey gi ya unn kay makano kay qareeb nazil hoti rahey gi ta-waqt-e-kay wada elahi phonchay. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa wada khilafi nahi kerta
Yaqeenan aap say pehlay kay payghumbaron ka mazaq uraya gaya tha aur mein ney bhi kafiron ko dheel di thi phir unhen pakar liya tha, pus mera azab kaisa raha?

Aaya woh Allah jo nigehbani kerney wala hai her shakhs ki, uss kay kiye huye aemaal per, unn logon ney Allah kay shareek thehraye hain keh dijiye zara unn kay naam to lo, kiya tum Allah ko woh baaten batatay ho jo woh zamin mein janta hi nahi, ya sirf oopri oopri baaten bata rahey ho, baat asal yeh hai kay kufur kerney walon kay liye unn kay makar saja diye gaye hain, aur woh sahih raah say rok diye gaye hain, aur jiss ko Allah gumrah ker dey uss ko raah dikhaney wala koi nahi
Unn kay liye duniya ki zindagi mein bhi azab hai, aur aakhirat ka azab to boht hi ziyadah sakht hai, unhen Allah kay ghazab say bachaney wala koi bhi nahi

Uss jannat ki sift, jiss ka wada perhezgaron ko diya gaya hai yeh hai kay uss kay neechay say nehren beh rahi hain. Uss ka mewa hameshgi wala hai aur uss ka saya bhi. Yeh hai anjam perhezgaron ka, aur kafiron ka anjam kaar dozakh hai

Jinhen hum ney kitab di hai woh to jo kuch aap per utara jata hai uss say khush hotay hain aur doosray firqay uss ki baaz baaton kay munkir hain. Aap ailaan ker dijiye kay mujhay to sirf yehi hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki ibadat keroon aur uss kay sath shareek na keroon, mein ussi ki taraf bula raha hun aur ussi ki janib mera lotna hai

Ussi tarah hum ney uss Quran ko arabi zaban ka farman utara hai. Agar aap ney unn ki khuwaishon ki pairwee ker li uss kay baad kay aap kay pass ilm chuka hai to Allah (kay azabon) say aap ko koi himayati milay ga aur na bachaney wala

Hum aap say pehlay bhi boht say rasool bhej chukay hain aur hum ney unn sab ko biwi bachon wala banaya tha, kissi rasool say nahi ho sakta kay koi nishani baghair Allah ki ijazat kay ley aaye. Her muqarrara waday ki aik likhat hai
Allah jo chahaye mita dey aur jo chahaye sabit rakhay, loh mehfooz ussi kay pass hai
Unn say kiye huye wadon mein say koi agar hum aap ko dikha den ya aap ko hum fot ker len to aap per to sirf phoncha dena hi hai. Hisab to humaray zimmay hi hai
Kiya woh nahi dekhtay? Kay hum zamin ko uss kay kinaron say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain, Allah hukum kerta hai koi uss kay ehkaam peechay dalney wala nahi, woh jald hisab lenay wala hai

Unn say pehlay logon ney bhi apni makkari mein kami na ki thi, lekin tamam tadbeeren Allah hi ki hain, jo shakhs jo kuch ker raha hai Allah kay ilm mein hai. Kafiron ko abhi maloom ho jaye ga kay (uss) jahaan ki jaza kiss kay liye hai?
Yeh kafir kehtay hain kay aap Allah kay rasool nahi. Aap jawab dijiye kay mujh mein aur tum mein Allah gawahi denay wala kafi hai aur woh jiss kay pass kitab ka ilm hai
